All adduct hypotheses of an annotated object

Source: R/AllGenerics.R, R/methods-XcmsExperiment.R
adductHints.Rd

adductHints() returns all neutral-mass hypotheses stored by annotateAdducts() as one long data.frame (one row per hypothesis and feature, columns as described in annotateAdducts()).

Usage

adductHints(object, ...)

# S4 method for class 'XcmsExperiment'
adductHints(object, ...)

Arguments

object

An xcms::XcmsExperiment annotated with annotateAdducts().

...

ignored.

Value

A data.frame.

Examples

library(xcms)
#> Loading required package: BiocParallel
#> 
#> This is xcms version 4.10.1 
library(MsFeatures)
if (requireNamespace("faahKO", quietly = TRUE)) {
    x <- loadXcmsData("xmse")
    x <- groupFeatures(x, SimilarRtimeParam(diffRt = 10))
    x <- annotateAdducts(x, AdductVoteParam())
    head(adductHints(x))
}
